title: Sol dynamical-regime OOS probe row
description: One out-of-sample probe for the v0.24.9 dynamical-regime classifier. Single row_type catalogue ('regime_probe'); each row records the probe's identity + 7-feature signature vector + expected_regime (or null for genuinely OOD cases) + ood_expected flag.

description.description: Human-readable probe description with key physical parameters.

time_scale_log_s.description: log10 of the body / sub-system's natural period in seconds.

spatial_scale_log_km.description: log10 of the natural length scale in kilometres.

has_commensurability.description: 1 if the probe carries an observable small-integer commensurability.

dimensionality.description: 0 = point dynamics, 1 = 1D chain, 2 = 2D surface family, 3 = 3D volume / continuum.

expected_regime.description: Expected regime label from the v0.24.0-v0.24.8 set, OR null if the probe is expected to be out-of-distribution.

ood_expected.description: True if the probe is expected to be flagged out-of-distribution (calibration ratio > 0.85).

notes.description: Per-row free-text notes — schema-gap closure history, surprising classification results.

source_published_date.description: ISO 8601 partial date for the cited source.

entered_locally_at.description: ISO 8601 date when this row was added to the AMSC catalogue.

source_version.description: Optional. For dataset/program release tags when applicable.
